episode_summary: In this episode, Bill Melnik shares his journey from a corporate career at Ralph Lauren to becoming a top luxury real estate agent. He emphasizes the importance of marketing lifestyle over square footage in the luxury market and discusses the role of AI in real estate. Bill also provides actionable insights on using social media for personal branding and the value of partnerships in closing high-end deals.
